meta.healthDefinition: Balance of switches reported in reviews, between apps both in our dataset. Not a measure of user growth.
meta.filters: customers only (rides & delivery drivers/couriers and unclear roles excluded); forced moves from shut-down apps excluded
meta.normalization: weight_per_10k = edge weight / reviews of the app the edge was observed in x 10,000. Weight: switch/return 1.0, intent 0.5, preference 0.25, x 0.7 for medium confidence.

reasons.label: Price & fees
reasons.description: subscription or product price, price increases, fees (transfer, instant, delivery, service), payouts/pay rates

reasons.label: Features & limits
reasons.description: a feature is missing, removed or paywalled; free-tier limits, swipe/skip/usage caps

reasons.label: Content & selection
reasons.description: catalog, selection, matches/people available, inventory, content quality or relevance, recommendations

reasons.label: Customer support
reasons.description: support quality, can't reach a human, disputes and refunds handled badly

reasons.label: Bugs & performance
reasons.description: crashes, glitches, slow app, battery drain, login loops, things not loading

reasons.label: Account & trust
reasons.description: account locked/banned/hacked, fraud, scams, fake profiles, money held, wrong charges

reasons.label: Speed & availability
reasons.description: service speed or availability: wait times, delivery or transfer speed, drivers/riders available, regions supported

reasons.label: Ads
reasons.description: too many ads, ad frequency or length, sponsored content

reasons.label: Policy & privacy
reasons.description: company policy, data/privacy, censorship/moderation, ethics, terms changes

reasons.label: Design changes
reasons.description: redesign, new layout, navigation changes, UI clutter
